def is_overdue(order: Order, today: date, *, log: Log) -> bool:
    late = order.due < today and order.status != "paid"
    log.write(f"{order.id} overdue={late}")
    return late

def close_order(order_id: str, *, store: OrderStore) -> Order:
    order = store.load(order_id)
    closed = order.close()
    store.save(closed)
    return closed
note: workflow only: the rule lives on Order.close, the writes on the store
